name: 358-tag
notes: #358 B2.a tag (replaces hop-circle for kid play): four kids at the gathering place, one play group (View/Beats/KidPlay.cs TagGame on the kit's ChaseGroup). The new chaser spins and bounces (wind-up), runs at its runner arms out, its right arm shoots out on the touch (hit; the runner jolts back: Flinch), both hold; the others run off waving and taunt; the old chaser runs off arms up. After 3-5 tags all sit panting (the end beat). AnimLab: same staging at the gathering place; cheat 'Kids play: tag'.
